mapper.update: UPDATE mes_kingdee_production_material_list m JOIN mes_pro_work_order w ON w.code = m.production_order_no AND CAST(w.code AS BINARY) = CAST(m.production_order_no AS BINARY) AND w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, work_order_id, item_id, MIN(id) id FROM mes_pro_work_order_bom WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY tenant_id, work_order_id, item_id ) b ON b.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND b.work_order_id = w.id AND b.item_id = m.child_material_id SET m.work_order_id = w.id, m.work_order_code = w.code, m.product_id = w.product_id, m.work_order_bom_id = b.id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND NOT (m.work_order_id <=> w.id AND m.work_order_code <=> w.code AND m.product_id <=> w.product_id AND m.work_order_bom_id <=> b.id)
